_comment: Caption Engine config. Every field is optional; omitted fields use DEFAULT_CAPTION_CONFIG in buildPlan.ts. heroSize and flatSize are px at a 1080-wide canvas. Split helper fragments each follow their local measured contour, so ascenders and descenders in one fragment never push a neighbour away from the hero. Latin pocket walls are classified explicitly (capitals and b/d/f/h/i/j/k/l/t above; g/j/p/q/y below), while measured ink supplies exact coordinates. nestle/sideClear/minGain control tightness; coverageBonus/enclosureBonus/splitPenalty decide whether helper text breaks and threads through multiple pockets. Helper-bearing heroes remain lowercase except for the rare high-impact poster beat controlled by powerUpperChance. style.textShadow and variation.accentChance are intentionally off by default.
